resources.string: Experimental, and against Spotify’s terms

This source plays Spotify audio outside Spotify’s own apps. Spotify can suspend an account used this way. The Unofficial engine is for a separate, throwaway account — never the one your library and playlists live on; it registers a device called Natune Player and reports what it plays. The Librespot engine plays as a Spotify Connect device on your library account instead, and needs Premium.

About the methods

The web player method needs Widevine on this device. The desktop method decrypts on the device and falls back to the web player method when it cannot resolve a track. They apply to the Unofficial engine.
